nodes.title: Positive conditioning — edit in green guidance node
widgets_values: Background motion only. Preserve the subject's identity, face, expression, mouth position, pose, framing, clothing, and the original composition. Animate only physically plausible environmental details: hair moves gently as if blown by a light wind, smoke billows slowly in the background, and street lights flicker intermittently. Subtle restrained motion, stable camera, seamless-loop-friendly pacing.

widgets_values: Locked camera and composition. Generate ample, clearly visible, voluminous smoke, fog, mist, and cloud billowing where those elements exist. Hair and loose fabric flow naturally in a steady breeze. Flags wave, water waves ripple, and underwater tentacles wriggle where present. Preserve faces, bodies, architecture, objects, framing, and identity. Other environmental movement may be subtle and physically plausible. Do not animate light sources spatially; lighting flicker is added later by the compositor.
